security_problem: mcp-visor --client-id is an operator string. If visor-session does not deliver a sealed VerifiedActorContext on a process-start fd, or if extra args can point visor at another fd/file, a caller can spoof identity.
required_behavior: FromChain produces a sealed verified_actor after verification. Command argv is serve -client-id -session-id -verified-actor-fd 3 plus extra policy flags. Extra args cannot set -verified-actor-fd or file aliases. Complete() requires the sealed context. Unix exec writes the JSON to fd 3.
failure_behavior: Incomplete mapping, missing sealed context, or extra identity flags are a process error and do not exec visor. tools/call fields are not a transport.
